scenes.title: Solleva la maniglia
scenes.summary: Hannah arrives for her first morning shift and Graham shows her the trick to the front door and his paper ledger.

scenes.title: Panini caldi e due squilli
scenes.summary: Morning baker Tessa welcomes Hannah with fresh bread and warns her about Room 4's double buzzer.

scenes.title: Dove sono i miei occhiali?
scenes.summary: Anxious owner Arthur rushes in worried about today's Room 4 arrival while hunting for the glasses on his forehead.

scenes.title: La camera quattro al secondo piano
scenes.summary: Retired piano teacher Evelyn checks into Room 4 with a heavy blue suitcase after a long train ride.

scenes.title: Non sono i miei vestiti!
scenes.summary: Upstairs in Room 4, Evelyn opens the blue suitcase and discovers men's shoes and a wooden toy train instead of her clothes.

scenes.title: L'etichetta del bagaglio
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Arthur reads the tiny handwriting on the suitcase tag while Hannah calls the station office.

scenes.title: Tè e un cardigan caldo
scenes.summary: Tessa lends Evelyn a clean soft cardigan and pours herbal tea while Graham locks the mystery suitcase safely away.

scenes.title: Lasciata sul gradino
scenes.summary: Late at night the front bell rings, and Hannah and Graham find Evelyn's real suitcase on the step with an anonymous note.
